thag15.2:1.1: Manussabhūtaṃ sambuddhaṃ attadantaṃ samāhitaṃ iriyamānaṃ Brahmapathe cittass' upasame rataṃ, || ||
thag15.2:2.1: yaṃ manussā namassanti sabbadhammāna pāraguṃ devāpi taṃ namassanti, iti me arahato sutaṃ,|| ||
thag15.2:3.1: sabbasaṃyojanātītaṃ vanā nibbanam āgataṃ kāmehi nikkhammarataṃ muttaselā va kañcanaṃ, || ||
thag15.2:4.1: sa ve accantarucī nāgo Himavāvaññe siluccaye, sabbesaṃ nāganāmānaṃ saccanāmo anuttaro: || ||
thag15.2:5.1: nāgaṃ vo kittayissāmi, na hi āguṃ karoti so. soraccaṃ avihiṃsā ca pādā nāgassa te duve. || ||
thag15.2:6.1: sati ca sampajaññañ ca caraṇā nāgassa te pare. saddhāhattho mahānāgo, upekkhāsetadantavā. || ||
thag15.2:7.1: sati gīvā, siro paññā, vīmaṃsā dhammacintanā, dhammakucchi, samāvāso, viveko tassa vāladhi. || ||
thag15.2:8.1: so jhāyī assāsarato ajjhattaṃ susamāhito, gacchaṃ samāhito nāgo, ṭhito nāgo samāhito,|| ||
thag15.2:9.1: sayaṃ samāhito nāgo, nisinno pi samāhito: sabbattha saṃvuto nāgo; esā nāgassa sampadā. || ||
thag15.2:10.1: bhuñjati anavajjāni, sāvajjāni na bhuñjati, ghāsaṃ acchādanaṃ laddhā sannidhiṃ parivajjayaṃ, || ||
thag15.2:11.1: saṃyojanaṃ aṇuṃ thūlaṃ sabbaṃ chetvāna bandhanaṃ, yena yen' eva gacchati anapekkho 'va gacchati. || ||
thag15.2:12.1: yathāpi udake jātaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ pavaḍḍhati, nopalippati toyena sucigandhaṃ manoramaṃ: || ||
thag15.2:13.1: tath' eva ca loke jāto buddho loke viharati, nopalippati lokena toyena padumaṃ yathā. || ||
thag15.2:14.1: mahāgini pajjalito anāhāro pasammati aṅgāresu ca santesu nibbuto 'ti pavuccati. || ||
thag15.2:15.1: atthassāyaṃ viññāpanī upamā viññūhi desitā, viññissanti mahānāgā nāgaṃ nāgena desitaṃ. || ||
thag15.2:16.1: vītarāgo vītadoso vītamoho anāsavo sarīraṃ vijahaṃ nāgo parinibbissaty anāsavo 'ti. || || Udāyī thero. tatr' uddānaṃ bhavati:
thag15.2:17.0: Koṇḍañño ca Udāyī ca therā dve te mahiddhikā Soḷasamhi nipātamhi, gāthāyo dve ca tiṃsa cā 'ti.
